notes: The grid covers the served map (flat3_straight: 239x215 cells at 5 cm from -18.53, -4.38) with half a metre of margin and 1.7 m of height from 15 cm below the floor. A frame integrates voxels within range_max of the camera; an observation from weight_ref_m weighs 1, nearer ones up to weight_cap, farther ones less. band_half_z_m is half the height band around the lidar's plane whose points are exact by construction and may seat a frame on the model; depth_fusion's live flag band_half_z starts from it. The plane itself is never written in a file twice: the node reads it from the published base_link -> laser edge (config/lidar.json's mount is the fallback). camera_band_m is the height band the camera speaks for (the band /depth_scan marks in, pepin.depth): the slice the camera sources localise against and the one that carries seats and tabletops, pepin.worldmap.
